drawn_objects: SHORT position tool, unchanged from IMG_7807: ENTRY 74,428.4 (grey), STOP 74,939.5 (red, top of pink box), TARGET 71,172.9 (teal, bottom of teal box). Verified again by pixel-mapping the box edges onto the calibrated axis (pink top -> 74,95x, teal bottom -> 71,12x).
Grey horizontal ZONE spanning ~73,774 to ~74,577, identical to IMG_7807. Price spiked into it and rejected.
Hand-drawn black UP arrow from the early-March low up to ~79k (unchanged).
Hand-drawn black DOWN arrow from the grey zone down through the teal target box, ending around 71.3k - and the actual candles have now FOLLOWED it down, closing at 71,364.5.
Red dotted last-price line at 71,364.5 with bar countdown 01:02:14 (TradingView last price, not a drawn level).
Purple lightning-bolt icon with red dot on the time axis near the 19th.
chart.visible_date_range: Day-of-month ticks 10, 13, 16, 19, 22 (March 2026); month/year not printed. Crosshair readout stamps the snapshot as Mar 18, 2026 20:27 UTC+5:30.
chart.what_the_drawing_says: This is the SAME BingX BTCUSDT 2h layout as IMG_7807 one day later, and it is the payoff image: price rejected the grey zone (~73,774-74,577) exactly as he required, sold off along his hand-drawn down arrow, and is now printing 71,364.5 - roughly 192 points above his 71,172.9 target and about 3,064 points below his 74,428.4 short entry. The trade is essentially at target with the stop (74,939.5) never threatened after the rejection. Two new tags have appeared far below (59,549.6 / 59,515.7) suggesting he has since drawn levels lower down.

notes: This is the single most checkable image in the batch: it is the RESULT of the setup posted in IMG_7807. Every axis tag was read at 6x zoom and then independently verified by pixel-calibrating the grey gridlines (87px per 2,000 units; price(y) = 80,000 - (y-1137)*22.989). Under that mapping the cyan dashed lines land on 82,506 and 62,666 (tags 82,490.4 / 62,694.3), the grey zone spans 74,563-73,760 (tags 74,577.3 / 73,773.7), the solid green line lands on 68,988 (tag 69,011.1), the pink stop-box top on ~74,95x (tag 74,939.5) and the teal target-box bottom on ~71,12x (tag 71,172.9). The position tool is therefore CONFIRMED unchanged from IMG_7807: short, entry 74,428.4, stop 74,939.5, target 71,172.9. QUANTIFIED OUTCOME: last price 71,364.5, i.e. ~3,064 points (~4.1%) below the marked entry and ~192 points short of the marked target, with the stop never approached. The grey axis values 80,000.0 / 78,000.0 / 72,000.0 / 66,000.0 / 64,000.0 / 60,000.0 are plain gridlines and are EXCLUDED from drawn_levels; 71,364.5 is the live last-price tag (it carries the 01:02:14 countdown) and is recorded as chart.last_price only. TIMESTAMP CAVEAT: the header of the first message ('FOMC - We Gonna Drop a bit...') is scrolled off the top of this screenshot, so its timestamp is set to null here rather than carried over - IMG_7809 shows the same message dated 18/03/2026 19:46, and dedup can supply it. Also note the chart snapshot is stamped 20:27 while the message posting it is 22:59, a ~2.5h gap. 'Ace Current thoughts about BTC 🤴 [image]' is a reply preview quoting his earlier 17/03 18:24 post, not a new statement. Three level tags are NEW relative to IMG_7807 (62,620.5 grey, 59,549.6 red, 59,515.7 red); 59,515.7 is clipped by the bottom edge of the attached image but its digits are legible. Spelling/grammar left verbatim.
